title: Morning account triage — Q2 renewal & follow-ups
content:
Quick notes / mental map for the morning triage — goal: 3 quick closes (renewal or unblock) and 2 engineering asks into triage queue.

Top priorities (today):
- Acme Logistics (risk: HIGH) — renewal 2026-08-12, exec sponsor (Dana R). Needs updated perf numbers and a cost forecast showing impact of dedicated vs hosted.
  - ask: get last 30-day per-token spend by model and 95th pct latency by route (data req to billing + telemetry) — owner: Liam P (ETA EOD today)
  - outreach: short note to Dana + procurement with 2 options: 1) 6mo Dedicated trial discount, 2) hosted + Optimize config w/ batching profile. Draft below.
  - blocker: legal wants private deployment checklist; link: CONFLUENCE/Acme-privacy (need to confirm with security)

- BetaBank (risk: MED) — new P0 support from yesterday (wanted strict PII extraction filter).
  - immediate: share redwood-filtering snippet + config example (recipes in shared CS snippets).
  - SRE ask: enable audit logging for their workspace for 72 hrs. Ticket created: SRE-789 (follow up with Harper).

- AtlasHealth (renewal not immediate, NBD) — QBR prep notes, want cost/perf story for embeddings migration.
  - prepare 3 slide bullets: current usage, projected savings with quantized embedding index, rollout plan + risk mitigation.

Daily micro-tasks (30–90m each):
- 09:00 quick sync (15m) with Liam & Harper — align asks, who owns which artifacts.
- 09:30 email Acme exec note (use template A) — cc: product & legal.
- 10:00 check alerts for BetaBank & Acme (Telemetry -> per-route errors).
- 11:00 draft QBR skeleton for AtlasHealth (3 bullets + data asks).
- 14:00 SRE sync (if needed) to prioritize audit/logging enablement.
- 16:00 final follow-ups and update tracker.

Risk matrix (quick):
- HIGH: Acme Logistics — commercial risk + exec attention. Failure to surface perf + cost = churn.
- MED: BetaBank — technical P0 but currently isolated. Fast SRE response likely enough.
- LOW: AtlasHealth — long renewal runway. Opportunity to show Optimize ROI.

Templates / snippets (copy-paste friendly) — use short, plain tone.
- Template A — Acme renewal outreach (email):
  Subject: Quick options to simplify Acme inference costs before Aug

  Hi Dana,

  Quick options for the Aug renewal window — 2 short paths we can put in front of procurement this week:
  1) 6-month Dedicated pilot (reserved pool, predictable throughput, SLA) — we can propose a pilot discount and configure a canary rollout for critical routes.
  2) Stay hosted + Redwood Optimize recommendations: target batching + prefix caching for freight-route, quantize model to int8 for infer-heavy endpoints — estimated 25–40% cost reduction.

  If you want, I can put together a one-page with exact delta numbers (cost + latency) — will need last 30 days usage. Do you prefer 1-pager or a short call (15m)?

  Best,
  Isabel

- Template B — BetaBank P0 ack (slack/email):
  "Hey team — we saw the P0. I opened SRE-789 to enable audit logs and pushed a config snippet for PII filtering to your workspace. Harper will own the SRE side; I will follow up with a working session at 10:30 if you can join."

Data requests to submit (quick list):
- billing export: per-model token counts last 30 days (CSV) — ask billing@redwood
- telemetry: 95th/99th latency per-route, per-model — ask telemetry team (Liam flagged)
- embed usage: top 5 users by query rate to see candidate for quantization

Parking lot / ideas (not today):
- Pre-baked small deck for renewals by tier (SaaS starter / mid-market / enterprise) — include cost delta examples.
- Quick internal checklist for private deployment: top 6 security docs legal asks for faster sign-off.

Open questions (to resolve before next sync):
- Does legal accept our standard arch-diagram for Acme (private control plane + customer KMS)? (ask: Anna in security)
- For BetaBank P0, is the required PII filter a transform (client-side) or inline inference-level? (ask: eng-solutions)

Quick checker before sending:
- Attach recent latency + cost numbers? -> yes if Liam returns today.
- Tag product on the email for fallback policy confirmation? -> yes.

End-of-day outcomes I want:
- Acme: 1-page options sent to Dana and procurement assigned an internal champion.
- BetaBank: SRE logging enabled + first config snippet validated.
- AtlasHealth: QBR skeleton + data requests in motion.

Notes to self (personal):
- keep messages short; execs respond to 2-option asks.
- mark follow-ups in linear: CS-RTN (create ticket after sends).
- hydrate (water)

-- scratchpad timestamp: 2026-06-30 08:42 (PDT)
